messages:
oliver: Heads-up — planning a rootfs trim for next base image. Goals: remove SUID bits from helpers, drop CAP_NET_RAW where not needed, and trim legacy packages (xz-utils, libfoo). Target window: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need RBAC scope changes for bake pipeline + audit hooks.

maya: Q — are we using the long-lived cosign key or a temporary signing key for this churn?

rachel: prefer short-lived subkey that can be cross-signed by prod key. That avoids breaking existing pins. Also we must remove cluster-admin from image-baker SA and scope to specific namespaces and the registry push SA.

sec-oncall: add structured audit events to the bake pipeline. Must capture: actor, action, image_sha, key_id and a trace id so we can link to runtime traces. Push to audit tenant.

jen: will add a preflight hook that writes a JSON line to /var/log/image-audit.log and forwards to the shipper. Minimal snippet: 

```bash
# preflight hook
echo '{"actor":"'$USER'","action":"bake","image":"'$IMAGE'","key":"'$KEY_ID'","audit_trace_id":"'$TRACE'"}' >> /var/log/image-audit.log
```

sam: I'll author a least-privilege RBAC policy. Initial perms: storage.objects.create on image bucket, iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob for signing agent, and no cluster-wide create rights. Drafting YAML now.

oliver: questions: 1) rollback plan if runtime regression, 2) how do consumers pin (digest vs tag)? Need clear rollback doc.

rachel: Rollback plan: keep previous signed image with a prebaked tag; canary at 5% for 30m then full roll. If regression, flip router to previous digest. Also prepare cosign key revocation steps in case of signing mistakes.

maya: KMS note: ephemeral keys complicate rollbacks. Alternate: sign with a delegated subkey authorized by offline main key; confirm keystore supports key versioning and envelope encryption. @platform-eng please confirm.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled bake job jb-8247 for 2026-03-30T02:00:00Z. Notifications to #eng-runtime and #eng-oncall.

sec-oncall: add an automated post-bake smoke test: run container, hit /health, check p90 < 200ms. Fail -> auto-fail rollout and revert routing.

jen: adding a post-bake smoke stage in CI with 10m window. Failure triggers rollback playbook: revert routing, open incident channel, preserve failing image for forensics. Also archive image-audit.log and cosign metadata to S3.

sam: FYI some teams pin by tag 'latest-stable' — we must communicate a tag freeze during the window. I'll post a checklist and repo notice.

oliver: checklist: 1) RBAC PR merged 48h prior, 2) audit-hook running in staging, 3) signing flow verified (KMS + cosign), 4) smoke tests passing, 5) rollback playbook published.

rachel: also request a 5% canary cohort for 30m before full cutover.

maya: dependency scanner flagged libfoo and xz-utils; removing xz-utils at runtime unless tests fail.

jen: added "audit_trace_id" to audit lines. Smoke pipeline tags failures and archives artifacts for triage.

sec-oncall: I'll write a short runbook section for postmortem steps and evidence collection.

oliver: thanks — reconvene Mon 16:00 UTC for final preflight. If no objections want RBAC PR by EOD Fri to hit Tue window. :thumbsup:

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4321 (ServiceAccount and RBAC YAML).

jen: hooks pushed to staging: https://git.internal/repo/ops/hooks/commit/ab12c. Smoke job tied to jb-8247.

ops-bot: checklist: RBAC PR: open, Audit hook: staging, Signing verification: pending, Smoke tests: pending.

maya: posting a brief customer-facing advisory to #customers-facing-apis about a short maintenance window.

oliver: closing thread for now — ping @everyone on Monday if anything blocks.
